_comment: TWO-TIER element rules from 60 NWDs. Tier1 (491) = SPECIFIC family/leaf (match=tree-path) — e.g. fire fittings, copper retic, duct shapes, hangers; Tier2 (432) = CATEGORY fallback (match=Category). First-match-wins, tier1 before tier2 per test. Replay: ~87% coverage, tier1 ~94% accurate where it fires. Unmatched left unassigned.

approve._comment: Conservative: only large clearances (>=50mm) on negotiable pairs; penetrations never approved; structure never approved.

approveKinds.name: Flex pipe (bends - approve even if hard clash)
Flex duct (bends - approve even if hard clash)

approve._approveComment: Always-approve (gap-independent, learned from data): Flex Pipes ~91% & Flex Ducts ~94% approved historically (flexible -> approved even on hard clashes); TUNDISH assignee ~90% approved. Everything else still needs clearance >= minGapMm and is never approved as a penetration or vs structure.
